name: Markdown for agents
description: Accept: text/markdown のGETを、ビルド時に生成した .md へ書き換える (ssg/run-markdown.ts)

rules.description: Markdown: ディレクトリURL -> index.md
rules.expression: (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/"))
(http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html"))
